sampleTime.description: Required. The time at which blood glucose was measured.

notes.description: Optional. Standard free-form notes captured at manual logging.

enumDescriptions: General measurement (not associated with a meal or time of day).

mealType.description: Optional. Meal type of the measurement.

BloodGlucose.description: Represents a blood glucose level measurement. LINT: LEGACY_NAMES

start.description: Required. The inclusive start of the range.

end.description: Required. The exclusive end of the range.

CivilTimeInterval.description: Counterpart of google.type.Interval, but using CivilDateTime.

metadata.description: Optional. Metadata for the sensor reading.

temperatureCelsius.description: Required. The temperature reading in Celsius.

measurementLocation.description: Optional. The location of the sensor measurement.

sensorType.description: Optional. The type of the sensor.

measurementState.description: Optional. The motion state of the sensor measurement.

serviceVersion.description: Output only. The service version used by the feature.

algorithmVersion.description: Output only. The algorithm version used by the feature.

featureVersion.description: Output only. The version of the feature/app running on the device.

deviceModel.description: Output only. The model name or device type of the compatible device used to collect the data.

firmwareVersion.description: Output only. The firmware version running on the compatible device used to collect the data.

MedicalDeviceInfo.description: Software as Medical Device (SaMD) metadata. Used to construct the Unique Device Identifier (UDI).

IrregularRhythmNotification.description: Represents an Irregular Rhythm Notification alert, indicating a potential sign of atrial fibrillation (AFib). This data type is based on SaMD feature and any changes to it may require additional review.

alertWindows.description: Optional. The overlapping analysis windows that were used to evaluate rhythm for potential AFib, containing specific information about the user's heart rhythm.

medicalDeviceInfo.description: Output only. The meta information for the compatible device used to conduct the measurement. Irregular Rhythm Notification measurements typically populate `algorithm_version`, `service_version`, and `device_model`.

highFrequencyPower.description: Optional. The power in interbeat interval fluctuations within the high frequency band (0.15 Hz - 0.4 Hz).

lowFrequencyPower.description: Optional. The power in interbeat interval fluctuations within the low frequency band (0.04 Hz - 0.15 Hz).

durationSum.description: The total time user spent sedentary during the interval.

SedentaryPeriodRollupValue.description: Represents the result of the rollup of the user's sedentary periods.

GoogleDevicesandservicesHealthV4User.description: Represents a user in the Google Health API. It matches the parent resource of collections owned by the user. Clients currently do not need to interact with this resource directly.

name.description: Identifier. The resource name of the user. The `{user}` ID is a system-generated identifier, as described in Identity.health_user_id. Format: `users/{user}`

StageSummary.description: Total duration and segment count for a stage.

count.description: Output only. Number of sleep stages segments.

type.description: Output only. Sleep stage type: AWAKE, DEEP, REM, LIGHT etc.

minutes.description: Output only. Total duration in minutes of a sleep stage.

result.description: Required. The result of the ovulation test.

sampleTime.description: Required. The time at which ovulation test was measured.

temperatureCelsiusAvg.description: Average core body temperature in Celsius.

temperatureCelsiusMin.description: Minimum core body temperature in Celsius.

temperatureCelsiusMax.description: Maximum core body temperature in Celsius.

CoreBodyTemperatureRollupValue.description: Represents the result of the rollup of the core body temperature data type.
